name: Layla's Falafel
notes: Menu and prices from the Westport location's own online ordering site, linked from the restaurant's website. Wraps and pitas show the starting price (a toasted wrap can cost more than a pita; for example chicken kabob is $15 as a wrap and $14 as a pita). The 'Specials' section repeated chicken kabob items and is left out. Everything is cooked without seed oils. Address, phone and hours from the website.
taglineEn: Lebanese falafel, shawarma and kabob platters made seed-oil free in Westport
taglineEs: Falafel, shawarma y platos de kebab libaneses sin aceites de semillas en Westport
